skill.displayName: 小红书评论分析与需求挖掘

llm.summary: This skill is a disclosed, read-only SocialDataX integration for fetching and analyzing Xiaohongshu comments using the user's API key.

dimensions.detail: The skill uses SOCIALDATAX_API_KEY and network calls to SocialDataX to retrieve comments. That access is proportionate to its purpose and disclosed, with no local browser/session scraping described.
dimensions.label: Credentials
dimensions.name: environment_proportionality

dimensions.detail: The skill depends on Node/npm and the socialdatax-skills package, including npx examples using the latest package version; this is disclosed in metadata and consistent with the integration, but users should trust the package source before use.
dimensions.label: Install Mechanism
dimensions.name: install_mechanism

dimensions.detail: Instructions are scoped to user-provided note URLs or complete note IDs, include output guidance to avoid overclaiming coverage, and explicitly separate visible comment evidence from analysis.
dimensions.label: Instruction Scope
dimensions.name: instruction_scope

dimensions.detail: No persistence, background worker, privilege escalation, posting, liking, commenting, deletion, or account mutation behavior is present in the artifact; it explicitly describes itself as read-only.
dimensions.label: Persistence & Privilege
dimensions.name: persistence_privilege

dimensions.detail: The stated purpose is Xiaohongshu/XHS comment analysis, pain-point extraction, FAQ creation, and feedback summarization, and the documented commands and MCP tools are limited to fetching note comments and replies for that purpose.
dimensions.label: Purpose & Capability
dimensions.name: purpose_capability

llm.guidance: Before installing, confirm you trust SocialDataX and the npm package it invokes. The skill will send provided Xiaohongshu note IDs or URLs through SocialDataX using your SOCIALDATAX_API_KEY, and broad options like --all may consume more API credits, so prefer page or item limits when exploring.
